info.title: Landing Public API (HTTP GET)
info.description: Read-only GET mirror of Landing's public MCP server. Same capabilities, callable with plain HTTP GET — for agents that cannot use MCP. No auth. Agent guide (llms.txt): https://www.hellolanding.com/llms.txt

get.summary: List the Landing markets currently accepting bookings (one row per market).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional 2-letter state abbreviation (e.g. "AL", "TX") to filter by.

get.summary: Returns all available filter options for a given market — bedroom counts, amenities, price range, bathroom options, neighborhoods, and sort orders.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Market slug (e.g. "austin-tx"). Use list_markets to discover slugs.

get.summary: Search Landing's published furnished apartments in a given market.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Market slug (e.g. "birmingham", "austin-tx"). Use list_markets to discover slugs.

parameters.name: check_in
parameters.description: Move-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Filters to homes available on or before this date.

parameters.name: check_out
parameters.description: Move-out date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a fixed stay, or "indefinite" for LandingFlex.

get.summary: Fetch a single Landing home by its slug — property details, amenities, photos, **flex pricing**, **the full availability calendar**, and a pre-filled `reservation_link` so the agent doesn't have to probe dates or assemble booking URLs by hand (get_apartment already returns the full calendar).
Return the flex (open-ended) commitment tiers a given home accepts, so the agent doesn't suggest a `committed_nights` value the home will reject.

Real, date-specific anonymous quote for a home. Mirrors what an unauthenticated visitor sees in checkout: monthly rent after seasonal adjustments and length-of-stay discounts, the first-month charge, ongoing monthly cost, and an estimated total.

parameters.name: check_out
parameters.description: Move-out date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a fixed stay, or the literal string "indefinite" for flex.

parameters.name: cats
parameters.description: Number of cats, if any. Priced into charge_schedule; omit or pass 0 for no cats.

parameters.name: dogs
parameters.description: Number of dogs, if any. Priced into charge_schedule; omit or pass 0 for no dogs.

get.summary: Market context for a Landing market: average monthly rent by bedroom count, total published inventory, and the neighborhoods with the most availability — useful for cross-market comparisons ("is Austin or Dallas cheaper for a 1BR?") without paging through search_apartments.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Market slug. Use list_markets to discover slugs.

parameters.name: home
parameters.description: Optional. When given, the response also includes this home's neighborhood context (description, walk/transit/bike score).

get.summary: Grounded, conservative answers to the most common Landing policy questions (deposits, pets, parking, cancellation, qualification, LandingFlex, utilities, move-in). Use this instead of guessing at policy specifics — where an exact number (deposit amount, cancellation window) depends on the home/market/reservation, the answer says so explicitly and points to get_quote, checkout, or Landing support rather than inventing a figure.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional — return only this topic's entry. Omit to get all entries.

entries.answer: Pet policies are set per home.
